title: Honky Tonk Central/9 Beds/Rtop Deck
description:
Book any 3 night weekend stay and get a 4th night absolutely FREE. TWO MILES TO BROADWAY!!!

Bachelor and Bachelorette parties welcome!!!!

The space
This gorgeous 4 bedroom, 4 bathroom home is exactly what you need for your Nashville vacation! With the most stunning new construction, patio with firepit, BEST DOWNTOWN VIEWS you`ll ever see and only being a short 3 mile ride to Broadway, Vanderbilt and "The Gulch" you`ll be super happy you landed here! This home is perfect for large groups, and so close to everything that you won`t need a rental car!

Each home has:

*4 Full Bathrooms with luxurious showers and tubs - Easy for Everyone to Get Ready

*Patio with Firepit

*Fast WiFi and Cable TV

*Free, Private Parking (Room for 2 Cars)

*Brand-new, Modern Kitchen

*Keyless Entry/Self Check-in

*Full-Sized Washer/Dryer for your Convenience

Bedroom 1) 1 King

Bedroom 2)1 King

Bedroom 3) 1 King

Bedroom 4) 6 Singles

We provide everything that a hotel will have. There will be enough tissue, paper towels, garbage bags, etc. to get you started. If you need additional supplies Walgreens is less than a mile away.
Bachelor and Bachelorette groups are welcome!!

Guest access
You`ll have 100% private access to this home during your entire stay, except for one closet that I keep for personal belongings and supplies.

Other things to note
We provide everything that a hotel will have. There will be enough tissue, paper towels, coffee, garbage bags, etc. to get you started. If you need additional supplies Walgreens is less than a mile away.
